subject: info-trns
title: INFO.TRNS.------ALT.C.PROG.
description: Chart 2 of 3 on book p. 104 (T(AF)M-8). INFO-TRNS (information transference) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; ALT-C-PROG is the partner. From the subject: SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics) and IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics). From SOC-RT-DY: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance). From PROG-CONT: LK-IMP (linkage implications). From LK-IMP: V-SY (value system) and APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions). From APP-RDEF: APP-RDEF-2 (applied redefinitions) and LG-DY (logical dynamics). From IF-ST-DY: INFO-CY. From INFO-CY: AFI (affinity insight).
